evidence: Run 33440641291 job 99648652218 failed at the first releases/tags request; release 380059708 remained a valid draft; gh release view resolved its numeric ID and the by-ID response passed validate-tag and verify-draft.
failure: GitHub Actions created an exact draft prerelease and uploaded both assets, then failed before publication because the workflow fetched the draft through the release-by-tag REST endpoint and received HTTP 404.
next_action: Require a draft-aware numeric release ID lookup in both workflow stages, retain exact tag and asset validation, prove the old lookup fails the contract test, and rerun the full release through GitHub Actions.
root_cause: The release workflow treated the published-release tag endpoint as draft-aware in both retry classification and prepublication verification. GitHub CLI can resolve drafts by tag and expose the numeric databaseId, while the exact live draft was readable through the release-by-ID endpoint.
